beats.say: Sir Patrick Stewart passed away at 86.
He was born in Mirfield, West Yorkshire, and went on to play Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek.
He was also a member of the Royal Shakespeare Company and was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II.
His final film performance will be in Avengers: Doomsday, according to Space.com.
Star Trek Online players held vigils to mourn his passing, showing his impact on fans worldwide.
That was the life of the beloved actor Patrick Stewart.
